about: Harness repair P2 gold relabels (user decision 2026-10-23: DO + partial instead of ROUND-17's whole-turn decline when a workflow the user asked for by name cannot take a setting but runs with its own). Applied over the harness gold (strictness audit, core items) by score.py; the original gold files are unchanged. P2b adds H18 and J41 under the user's decision (a) (2026-10-23): a setting the run-named workflow cannot take is DO + partial even within the run's own words.

hb-h2main-J44-1.why: OTTER rerun named; computing=gpu is not enabled in this runtime, OTTER runs on CPU. DO + partial: the GPU setting declined with its reason, the run held for the user.

hb-h3main-L21-1.why: 'Please run GIRAFFE' named; GIRAFFE takes no settings and runs with its package defaults. DO + partial: learning rate, iterations and loss weight declined, the run held.

hb-h1-H40-1.why: 'I'd like GIRAFFE run' named; as L21. DO + partial, the run held.

hb-h1-H18-1.why: 'With DRAGON, I'd like ... a lambda_inter of 0.2' names the run in the setting's own sentence; DRAGON runs with its own lambdas. User decision (a) 2026-10-23: a single-row setting the named workflow cannot take is DO + partial -- lambda_inter declined, the question row held with it, the run held.

hb-h2main-J41-1.why: 'BONOBO should write each per-sample co-expression matrix ... as a .parquet file' names BONOBO; it runs with its own output format. Decision (a): DO + partial -- the parquet format declined, the run held.

not_relabelled.hb-h3main-L13-1: LIONESS-DRAGON past its size cap: a run limit, nothing of that run can be produced -- stays DECLINE.
not_relabelled.hb-h1-H18-1: Superseded in P2b by decision (a): relabelled DO (see relabels).
not_relabelled.cj-*-C08-1: 'Can GIRAFFE be run with my own optimizer settings?' -- a capability question whose doable rows are a purpose or background phrase; stays DECLINE.
not_relabelled.a24b MX04, MX05: Not in the harness gold (unlabelled ve-m3 sessions); both replay as DO + partial, as the a24b gold has them.
